high_level_description: This image captures a serene scene of a person sitting on the edge of a boat, gazing out over a body of water during what appears to be either sunrise or sunset. The sky is painted with soft hues of orange, pink, and blue, reflecting beautifully on the calm water surface. The horizon is lined with silhouettes of trees, adding depth to the landscape. The person, dressed in a white outfit with black trim, has long hair that flows down their back. They are seated on the boat, leaning slightly forward with one hand resting on the edge of the boat and the other hanging by their side.
